rationale: A research project can perform valid revenue arithmetic while mislabeling a derivatives-inclusive numerator as a spot fee. A second scope problem arises when USDC revenue is compared with balances using inconsistent units or periods. Preserve useful arithmetic and mark the non-identifiable fee inference unresolved.
exposure: Reference/control verification only, no candidate-model exposure
reference_method: Independent Python Decimal calculations from source facts, separate from submitted SQL
candidate_view_review: Source headings, signs, periods and relevant definitions directly inspected before model exposure

contract_revision.changes: Explicit input database, output directory and existing basename restriction
